name: accordion-47
description: Security checkup where each item shows a pass or warning status and a fix action.

files.content:
import { ChevronDownIcon, CircleCheckIcon, ShieldAlertIcon, TriangleAlertIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/accordion" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const checks = [ { value: "password", title: "Strong password", ok: true, body: "Your password was changed 2 months ago and is not found in known breaches.", }, { value: "2fa", title: "Two-factor authentication", ok: false, body: "Add an authenticator app so a stolen password alone cannot unlock your account.", action: "Enable 2FA", }, { value: "sessions", title: "Active sessions", ok: false, body: "You are signed in on 4 devices, including one you have not used in 90 days.", action: "Review sessions", }, { value: "recovery", title: "Recovery email", ok: true, body: "Recovery codes will be sent to r***@hollow.example.", }, ] export default function AccordionSecurityCheckup() { const issues = checks.filter((check) => !check.ok).length return (

{issues} recommendations

Fix these to keep your account safe.

{checks.map((check) => ( {check.ok ? ( ) : ( )} {check.title}

{check.body}

{check.action && } ))}
) }
